# Albus

> Albus runs agent sessions over an HTTP API. You send a prompt and an agent
> configuration; Albus executes the model loop, connects the MCP servers you
> declare, and returns the assistant's reply. Agents can search the web, run
> commands in a sandboxed terminal, keep memory across sessions, and answer in a
> JSON schema you give them; every invocation is recorded as a trace.

## Agent Instructions

If you are a coding agent setting Albus up or writing code against it, read
https://docs.albus.sh/agents/docs.md first — it is self-contained: setup, the
whole API surface, the rules, and runnable examples. Every page below is also
available as Markdown at the same URL with `.md` appended.

## Start here

- [Albus for coding agents](https://docs.albus.sh/agents/docs.md): One page — setup, the whole API surface, the rules, and runnable examples.
- [Albus](https://docs.albus.sh/index.md): What Albus does, and your first session with the CLI, Python, TypeScript, or curl.
- [Authentication](https://docs.albus.sh/getting-started/authentication.md): Install the CLI, sign in, or mint an organization API key for scripts and CI.

## Guides

- [Build an agent](https://docs.albus.sh/guides/build-an-agent.md): From a bare model to invocation keys, tools, secrets, MCP servers, memory, traces, revisions, and the audit log — one addition at a time.
- [Bring your own key](https://docs.albus.sh/guides/bring-your-own-key.md): Run a session on your own model provider account.
- [Built-in tools](https://docs.albus.sh/guides/built-in-tools.md): What web search, the terminal, and memory do and how to enable each.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.albus.sh/guides/troubleshooting.md): Match an error to its cause and its fix.

## Reference

- [CLI](https://docs.albus.sh/reference/cli.md): Every `albus` command, flag, environment variable, and exit code.
- [SDKs](https://docs.albus.sh/reference/sdks.md): The Python and TypeScript clients — install, auth, responses, errors.
- [Errors](https://docs.albus.sh/reference/errors.md): Every status code, its body, and the fix.
- [API reference](https://docs.albus.sh/api-reference): The generated HTTP contract and playground.
